svg.title: Our own SLM (small local models), in one image
svg.text: How we trained them, one per use case.
Three SLM of our own, taught by the cloud models
the logged calls of the job
A run on a rented GPU costs 0.4 to 1.6 USD. The cloud model stays the fallback.
Discard incidents: is a still screen a menu or a stuck video?
Taught by Haiku and Sonnet on 4,235 sure freeze rows. Runs on the server.
Which known screen is this, when the fingerprint is not sure?
Taught by Haiku, with Sonnet on the near-ties. Answers the Localize calls of its box.
Name a screen Localize does not know
Taught by Sonnet on 3,621 lab screenshots, Opus judging the disagreements.
Next: faster. Reading the picture takes most of the 2.6 s; the answer about 0.3 s.
Each round one GPU run: better labels, not a bigger model
Taught by the cloud models. Answers only when sure.
The rest goes to the cloud model, as before.
